summary: Construct a TypedArray view over an existing buffer with alignment and length-tracking semantics.

semantics.byte_offset: ToIndex and must align to element size
semantics.length: fixed when explicit; length-tracking when omitted on resizable/growable buffers

tests.name: shares backing
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(4); const a=new Uint16Array(b); a[0]=0x1234; console.log(new Uint8Array(b).some(x=>x!==0));
